title: The Bridge That Should Not Stand

collection.credit:
CREDITS: Lorsieab2 proposed making the full competition suite available in
VV1, VV2, VV3, VV4 and VV5, rewriting each to reflect its setting, and
specifically proposed VV5 Heathen/Isolan competitors and judges with political
tensions. The original VV2 Cooking Contest's premise, mechanics and text are
by Lorsieab2. The game-specific adaptations, fresh dialogue, branching,
political plots and integration notes below are written by ChatGPT.
Existing universal competitions and their previous credits remain intact.

contest.text:
The village gathers beneath the sound of the Great Falls. The Lost Children help prepare decorations, keep score and, sometimes, interfere spectacularly.
A competition to span a shallow stream produces a beautiful bridge and an impossibly thin structure of woven reeds. The master builder calls the second "a fishing net with delusions." The reed bridge supports three adults, then sways so alarmingly that nobody volunteers to be fourth.
contest.name: The Bridge That Should Not Stand

b.text: The unusual design may prove sound or require reinforcement; do not let children test an unverified bridge.
